name: Itinerary A: No Mid-Trip Rest, Spoleto Final Base
description: Continuous property hunting across central and northern Italy. The long stay bases (Narni, Manciano, and Castiglione del Lago) are separated by strategic short stays (Gaeta, Teramo, Macerata, Alba) to avoid consecutive long stays, keeping driving under 4 hours and ending in Spoleto.

name: Itinerary B: No Mid-Trip Rest, Manciano Final Base
description: Continuous property hunting similar to Itinerary A, but ends with a 10-night final base in Manciano (Grosseto), offering a deep-dive exploration of southern Tuscany at the end of the trip.

name: Itinerary C: Early Rest Week, Spoleto Final Base
description: Introduces an early vacation rest week right after the first long stay, providing a more relaxed pacing before diving into the remaining long stays in Manciano and Castiglione del Lago.

name: Itinerary D: Pre-Piemonte Rest, Spoleto Final Base
description: Places the vacation rest week late in the trip, immediately before traveling north to Alba and Milan. This creates a solid block of relaxation after completing all three major property-hunting long stays.
